description:
List the coach's current channel accounts, one per provider account, with each one's status, health, and what the composer can send through it. Connecting, pausing, and repairing an account stay in the Luca app.

Luca operation: GET /api/channels
Required scopes: channels:read
Required OAuth scope: luca:read; data sensitivity: redacted
Does not require idempotency.
Use workspaceId or workspaceSlug to override the default workspace configured by environment.
name: luca_channels_list
title: List channel accounts
